archetype: Esper ({W}{U}{B}) Artifact Creature Swarm, Double Strike & Assimilate Midrange

justifications.r1: Strong 38-land base (replacing Skycloud Expanse with untapped Sea of Clouds) backed by 16 ramp/cost-reduction/untap pieces including Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, all three Talismans, Fellwar Stone, Etherium Sculptor, Wayfarer's Bauble, Everflowing Chalice, Astral Cornucopia, Commander's Sphere, Queen's Diamond, Urza, Lord High Artificer, Type-03 Borg Vessel, Võx, Child of the Collective, and Unwinding Clock — enabling Turn 3–6 Borg Queen lines (60% T<=7 readiness in Bracket 3 goldfish).
justifications.r2: High-velocity artifact draw engine featuring Skullclamp, Thoughtcast, Voyage Home, Thirst for Knowledge, Co-Option Adjutant, Sai, Master Thopterist, Seven of Nine, Tertiary Adjunct, Reclamation Specialist, The Immortal Sun, Collective Override, and Urza, Lord High Artificer's repeatable {5} library impulse.
justifications.a1: Tight functional redundancy across Borg and artifact-token generators (Locutus of Borg, Antagonist Incorporator, Illustrious Wanderglyph, Sai, Master Thopterist, Conquest Mission, Maturation Chamber, Class-4 Tactical Cube) paired with multiple +2/+2 lords and keyword finishers (Tempered Steel, Primary Unimatrix Adjunct, One, Borg Evolved, Akroma's Will).
justifications.a2: Deploys 2-CMC mana rocks, Etherium Sculptor, Antagonist Incorporator, and Maturation Chamber on Turns 2–3, establishing Urza, Sai, Conquest Mission, or Liberator flash velocity by Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Critical threat onset shifts up to Turn 6 when Illustrious Wanderglyph (+2/+2), Primary Unimatrix Adjunct (double strike), Cyberdrive Awakener (flying + 4/4 rocks), Akroma's Will, or The Borg Queen converts wide artifact armies into lethal multi-player combat pressure.
justifications.p2: Compact 1-response-cycle closing power through Cyberdrive Awakener mass rock animation, Primary Unimatrix Adjunct double strike, Akroma's Will (choosing both modes with The Borg Queen out), and One, Borg Evolved.
justifications.p3: Combat damage still funnels through the combat step and visible board buildup, though Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter grants flash deployment speed on opponents' end steps to shrink opponent response windows.
justifications.i1: Upgraded Esper interaction package pairing Path to Exile, Dispatch, Bitter Triumph, Anguished Unmaking, Disallow, and Deliver from Chaos with three scalable sweepers (Toxic Deluge, Battle of Wolf 359, Organic Extinction).
justifications.i2: Asymmetrical suppression led by Organic Extinction (Improvise wipe sparing all artifact creatures), Battle of Wolf 359, The Flesh Is Weak (continuous -1/-1 against nonartifact creatures), and The Immortal Sun.
justifications.s1: Premier instant-speed shielding across Akroma's Will (indestructible + protection from all colors), Emergency Regeneration (team hexproof + indestructible), Borg Incursion, Swiftfoot Boots, One, Borg Evolved (ward {2}), and Liberator flash timing.
justifications.s2: Steady post-wipe recovery via Academy Ruins, Illustrious Wanderglyph creating a Gnome every upkeep (4 per table cycle), Sai, Master Thopterist rebuilding flying Thopters on artifact casts, and Voyage Home refilling three cards.
justifications.s3: Resilient commander-independent win paths via Urza, Lord High Artificer, Illustrious Wanderglyph, Cyberdrive Awakener, Primary Unimatrix Adjunct, Locutus of Borg, and One, Borg Evolved even when The Borg Queen is taxed out.

overview: Phase 1 Bracket 3 upgrade of The Borg Queen ({4}{W}{U}{B}) Esper Artifact Creature Swarm deck (0 / 3 Game Changers). Retaining The Borg Queen's +2/+2 anthem and Assimilate engine alongside Queen's Diamond and Locutus of Borg, this 15-card overhaul cuts Skycloud Expanse, sluggish 4-CMC rocks, and off-plan nonbos to inject untapped Battlebond fixing (Sea of Clouds), 2-CMC velocity (Fellwar Stone, Etherium Sculptor, Antagonist Incorporator), flash speed (Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter), artifact token multipliers (Sai, Master Thopterist, Illustrious Wanderglyph, Urza, Lord High Artificer), asymmetrical Improvise removal (Organic Extinction, Path to Exile, The Flesh Is Weak), and decisive flying/double-strike finishers (Primary Unimatrix Adjunct, Cyberdrive Awakener, Akroma's Will).

core_strategy: Turns 1–3: Curve out with untapped duals (Sea of Clouds, Morphic Pool, Spire of Industry), 2-CMC rocks (Talismans, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone), Etherium Sculptor, Wayfarer's Bauble, and early Borg/draw pieces (Antagonist Incorporator, Command Subadjunct, Extraction Integrant, Maturation Chamber, Skullclamp).

Turns 4–5: Establish token and mana engines with Urza, Lord High Artificer, Sai, Master Thopterist, Illustrious Wanderglyph, Locutus of Borg, Co-Option Adjutant, Type-03 Borg Vessel, or Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter (allowing end-step artifact deployment).
Turns 5–6: Cast The Borg Queen ({4}{W}{U}{B}) via Urza mana or a charged Queen's Diamond to grant +2/+2 across all artifact creatures and assimilate opponents' top-deck threats on ETB and attack.

Close-Out: Break board stalls cleanly via Organic Extinction or Battle of Wolf 359, then end the game in one combat step with Cyberdrive Awakener, Primary Unimatrix Adjunct, One, Borg Evolved, or Akroma's Will.

keep: Hands with 3+ lands (preferring untapped sources like Sea of Clouds, Command Tower, or Morphic Pool), at least one 1–2 CMC ramp/discount piece (Sol Ring, Talismans, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, Etherium Sculptor), and an early draw or token piece (Skullclamp, Voyage Home, Antagonist Incorporator, Maturation Chamber).
avoid: All-tapped land openers lacking 2-CMC acceleration, or clunky 6–7 CMC hands without Urza, Queen's Diamond, or draw velocity.

key_tips: Urza, Lord High Artificer turns every summoning-sick Borg token, Thopter, Gnome, and Clue/Spacecraft into {U} on the turn it enters, accelerating 7-CMC The Borg Queen as early as Turn 3–5.

With Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter on board, hold up interaction (Akroma's Will, Emergency Regeneration, Disallow, Path to Exile) and flash in Illustrious Wanderglyph or Cyberdrive Awakener on the last opponent's end step.

Pair Antagonist Incorporator and Locutus of Borg with Primary Unimatrix Adjunct or Akroma's Will: double strike triggers combat-damage token generation and Co-Option Adjutant card draw twice per creature.

The Flesh Is Weak puts a +1/+1 counter on nonartifact creatures like Sai, Master Thopterist and Urza, Lord High Artificer—converting them into artifacts so they benefit from The Borg Queen, Tempered Steel, and survive Organic Extinction and Battle of Wolf 359.

critical: 7-CMC commander cost paired with 12 remaining precon taplands (cycling duals, Evolving Wilds, Terramorphic Expanse, Arcane Sanctum, Path of Ancestry) still yields a Turn 6.9 average deployment (60% T<=7 Bracket 3 readiness) until Phase 2 fetch/shock/bond land upgrades.
Broad artifact exile sweepers (Farewell, Austere Command) still hit artifact creatures and noncreature rocks simultaneously unless shielded by Emergency Regeneration or Akroma's Will.
moderate: Zero instant/sorcery tutors for noncreature finishers keeps Akroma's Will and Tempered Steel dependent on draw velocity (Voyage Home, Co-Option Adjutant, Skullclamp).

Anthem stacking (+2/+2 from The Borg Queen, Tempered Steel, Illustrious Wanderglyph) turns off Skullclamp's effortless 1-toughness token sacrifice outlet late game (use Sai, Master Thopterist or Reclamation Specialist instead).
minor: Reliance on combat phase makes Propaganda/Ghostly Prison effects mildly annoying until answered by Anguished Unmaking or overwhelmed with Urza mana.
